summary: AnsibleModule.log masks its message and log_args, the invocation log always shows no_log options as $REDACTED$, and respawned modules keep and return secrets normally.
questions: Are no_log values masked in the module invocation log?
Do secrets survive when a module respawns under another Python?

answer_card.title: Module logging and respawn masking
answer_card.answer_md: `AnsibleModule.log()` masks its message and `log_args`. The invocation log entry always shows `no_log` options as `$REDACTED$` regardless of length. Respawned modules keep the controller's secrets and return newly registered ones as usual.
